guideline_authority: World Health Organization (WHO) Hemoglobin Concentrations for the Diagnosis of Anaemia

clinical_actions.NORMAL: Estimated hemoglobin is in the healthy normal range.
clinical_actions.MILD_ANEMIA: Slightly low. Consider iron-rich foods and consult a doctor if fatigued.
clinical_actions.MODERATE_ANEMIA: Consult a doctor for a complete blood test (CBC) to confirm.
clinical_actions.SEVERE_ANEMIA: Prompt medical evaluation advised. Please consult a doctor.

disclaimer: AnemiaSense provides automated optical screening and risk stratification. Results are not a standalone diagnostic decision and must be confirmed via standard laboratory venous phlebotomy.
